environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' with a single RegexPatternSet rule matching request URI query string components against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|'\s*;\s*--|extractvalue|load_file)` with action BLOCK, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in COUNT mode (monitoring only, not blocking). The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics are enabled for all rule groups. The custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' has a priority of 2 and capacity of 25 WCUs. The regex inspection applies to the SingleQueryArgument 'value' in the request.

config.waf_rule_group_2: corp-input-validation: RegexPatternSet on query arg 'value', pattern covers UNION SELECT and stacked queries, action BLOCK
